id: 17_Laboratory Safety Mitigating Electrical Risks and Hazards in the Workplace Train
title: 看懂电，管住电气危害
source_doc: course/Lab Safety Training - Essential Protocols/17_Laboratory Safety Mitigating Electrical Risks and Hazards in the Workplace Train.md
author_source: project/Lab Safety Training - Essential Protocols/17_Laboratory Safety Mitigating Electrical Risks and Hazards in the Workplace Train/src.py

points.K10: 按电流选导线和保护器
points.K23: 插线板：匹配负载、临时使用
points.S3: 高压电源：先断电，不拆联锁

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验台旁，台上有仪器和插线板，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a lab bench with instruments and a power strip, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课，看懂电，管住电气危害。

shots.scene: 电压、电流、电阻、功率四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a battery with a plus sign, a flowing arrow along a wire, a zigzag resistor and a light bulb. No people.
shots.narration: 先懂电，再防电。

shots.scene: 阿杰把一台加热器和几台仪器都插在同一个插线板上
shots.prompt_en: The young male student plugs a heater and several instruments into one crowded power strip on the bench.
shots.narration: 阿杰图方便，什么都插一个插线板。

shots.scene: 插线板发烫冒出热浪图标，小研赶紧拔下加热器
shots.prompt_en: Heat wave icons rise from the crowded power strip; the female graduate student quickly unplugs the heater.
shots.narration: 小研摸到插线板发烫，赶紧拔掉。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在空白白板前，白板旁四个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard with four icons beside it: battery, arrow, resistor, bulb.
shots.narration: 电压、电流、电阻、功率，是安全用电的基础。

shots.scene: 水管示意：水泵推动水流，类比电压推动电流
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram: a pump pushes water through a pipe, next to a battery pushing small charge dots along a wire. No people.
shots.narration: 电压推动电流，就像水压推动水流。

shots.scene: 电压表指针升高，旁边出现闪电警示
shots.prompt_en: A voltage gauge needle rises and a lightning warning triangle appears beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 电压越高，电击和设备损坏的风险越大。

shots.scene: 高压警示牌旁，绝缘手套和护目镜图标
shots.prompt_en: A high voltage warning sign next to icons of insulating gloves and safety goggles. No people.
shots.narration: 知道电压多高，才知道该怎么防护。

shots.scene: 水管变窄，水流变慢；导线中的电阻符号
shots.prompt_en: A pipe that narrows and slows the water, next to a zigzag resistor symbol on a wire. No people.
shots.narration: 电阻是材料对电流的阻碍。

shots.scene: 接头松动处发红发热
shots.prompt_en: A loose wire connection glowing red with heat wave icons. No people.
shots.narration: 接触不良，局部电阻大，就会发热。

shots.scene: 两根导线碰在一起冒出火花，短路图标
shots.prompt_en: Two bare wires touching with a spark, a short circuit icon. No people.
shots.narration: 电阻太小，电流猛增，也很危险。

shots.scene: 灯泡和加热器图标，旁边是电压乘电流的图示
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a small bulb and a large heater, with a battery icon and a flowing arrow icon combining into a lightning bolt. No people.
shots.narration: 功率是用电的快慢，由电压和电流决定。

shots.scene: 大功率加热器上方热浪滚滚
shots.prompt_en: A large heater icon with strong heat waves rising above it and a thermometer going up. No people.
shots.narration: 功率越大，发热越多，风险越高。

shots.scene: 导线剖面，里面许多小点沿箭头流动
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway of a wire with many small dots flowing along an arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 电流，就是导线里流过的电。

shots.scene: 电流经过手臂的小人图标，旁边闪电
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram with a lightning arrow passing through the arm, with a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 电击伤人，靠的是流过身体的电流。

shots.scene: 细导线发红冒烟的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a thin wire glowing red and smoking under a large current arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 电流过大会发热，引起灼伤或火灾。

shots.scene: 低电压图标旁也出现警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A low voltage battery icon with a warning triangle beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 电压不高，也不能掉以轻心。

shots.section_title: 按电流选导线和保护器
shots.scene: 老李在配电箱前检查断路器和熔断器
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks circuit breakers and fuses in an open distribution box.
shots.narration: 按电流大小，选导线、断路器和熔断器。
overlay: 按电流选导线和保护器

shots.scene: 两条箭头：一条直线向前，一条来回波动
shots.prompt_en: Two arrows: one straight arrow moving forward and one wavy line moving back and forth. No people.
shots.narration: 电流分直流和交流两种。

shots.scene: 电池、手机、实验室直流电源三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a battery, a mobile phone and a lab benchtop power supply with a blank display. No people.
shots.narration: 直流方向不变，电池和电子设备都用它。

shots.scene: 小研在实验台上调节直流电源
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student adjusts the knob of a benchtop power supply with a blank display.
shots.narration: 实验室常用直流电源，提供稳定电压。

shots.scene: 墙上插座、输电塔、冰箱三个图标，波浪线连接
shots.prompt_en: Three icons linked by a wavy line: a power tower, a wall socket and a refrigerator. No people.
shots.narration: 交流电来回换向，电网送的就是交流。

shots.scene: 风扇和冰箱的电机图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a fan and a refrigerator with a small motor symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 便于远距离输送，电器电机多用它。

shots.scene: 高压警示标志，旁边波浪线
shots.prompt_en: A high voltage warning sign next to a wavy alternating current line. No people.
shots.narration: 高压交流电，非常危险。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现六个危害图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside six floating hazard icons in a grid.
shots.narration: 实验室的电气危害，主要有六类。

shots.scene: 被电击后惊跳摔倒、碰到玻璃器皿被割伤的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person jerking back from a shock and knocking over glassware, with a small cut mark. No people.
shots.narration: 被电一下吓得摔倒、割伤，也算在内。

shots.scene: 带电导线、故障设备、裸露端子三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a live bare wire, an instrument with a broken casing, and exposed terminals with a lightning mark. No people.
shots.narration: 碰到带电导线、故障设备、裸露部件，

shots.scene: 手伸向裸露端子的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand reaching toward exposed live terminals, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 就可能被电击。

shots.scene: 高压大电流图标旁，心电图变成直线
shots.prompt_en: A high voltage icon beside a heartbeat line that turns into a flat line, with a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 高电压、大电流的电击，可能致命。

shots.scene: 两个电极之间跳出一道明亮电弧
shots.prompt_en: A bright electric arc jumps across a gap between two terminals, with heat rays around it. No people.
shots.narration: 电流跨过间隙放电，会形成电弧。

shots.scene: 短路、设备故障、高压源三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a short circuit spark, a broken instrument and a high voltage sign. No people.
shots.narration: 电弧温度极高，会造成严重灼伤。

shots.scene: 导线过热、短路、火花点燃纸张三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: an overheated glowing wire, a short circuit spark, and a spark landing on paper that catches fire. No people.
shots.narration: 导线过热、短路、火花，都会引起火灾。

shots.scene: 插座冒烟的图标，旁边火焰警示
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a wall socket with smoke rising, next to a flame warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 电气火灾，是最危险的电气事故。

shots.scene: 手指靠近金属把手冒出小火花
shots.prompt_en: A small static spark jumps from a fingertip to a metal handle. No people.
shots.narration: 物体表面积聚电荷，就是静电。

shots.scene: 静电火花靠近溶剂蒸气云，出现火焰警示
shots.prompt_en: A static spark near a faint vapor cloud above a solvent bottle, with a flame warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 静电放电，能点燃易燃蒸气、气体和粉尘。

shots.scene: 电路板图标上出现裂纹闪电
shots.prompt_en: A circuit board icon with a small lightning crack on a chip. No people.
shots.narration: 还会损坏精密电子元件。

shots.scene: 欣欣竖起大拇指，身旁有盾牌图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot gives a thumbs up beside a shield icon.
shots.narration: 危害听着吓人，其实都能预防。

shots.scene: 磨破的电线、裸露导体、松动接头三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a frayed cable, an exposed copper conductor and a loose plug connection. No people.
shots.narration: 常查电线：有没有磨损、裸露、松动。

shots.scene: 老李把破损电线换成新电线
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer replaces a damaged power cord with a new one on an instrument that is unplugged.
shots.narration: 坏了旧了，立即更换。

shots.section_title: 插线板：匹配负载、临时使用
shots.scene: 插线板上的空白额定值标签和设备功率标签对比
shots.prompt_en: A power strip with a blank rating label next to an instrument with a blank power label, a balance icon between them. No people.
shots.narration: 插线板的额定值，要和用电负载匹配。
overlay: 插线板：匹配负载、临时使用

shots.section_title: 插线板：匹配负载、临时使用
shots.scene: 破损的插线板图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a cracked, scorched power strip, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 破损的插线板，不能再用。

shots.section_title: 插线板：匹配负载、临时使用
shots.scene: 插线板旁出现时钟图标
shots.prompt_en: A power strip with a small clock icon beside it, showing temporary use. No people.
shots.narration: 插线板只作临时用，不能长期替代布线。

shots.scene: 电缆外皮完好，穿过保护套管
shots.prompt_en: A power cable with intact insulation running through a protective conduit along the wall. No people.
shots.narration: 电线电缆绝缘要完好，

shots.scene: 电线被椅子压住、被门夹住的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a cable crushed under a chair wheel and pinched in a door, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别让它被压、被夹、被磨。

shots.scene: 三孔插头插入三孔插座，接地线图标
shots.prompt_en: A three-pin plug going into a matching three-hole wall socket, with a ground symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 三孔插头的设备，要可靠接地。

shots.scene: 掰掉接地脚、插两孔插座的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a three-pin plug with its ground pin broken off forced into a two-hole socket, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不掰接地脚，不用没接地的插座。

shots.scene: 阿杰湿着手去拔插头的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a wet hand reaching for a plug, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 湿手不碰插头、开关和电器。

shots.scene: 水槽旁的插座被打叉，远处的插座打勾
shots.prompt_en: A socket right next to a lab sink crossed out with a red X; a socket far from the sink with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 插座、插线板，远离水槽和液体。

shots.scene: 仪器上方放着烧杯的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a beaker of liquid placed on top of an instrument, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 盛液体的容器，不放在电器上方。

shots.scene: 插线板串插线板的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of one power strip plugged into another power strip, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 插线板不串接。

shots.scene: 插线板固定在台面下方，地上的乱线被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A power strip mounted under a bench edge with a green check; tangled cords on the floor crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不放在地上，不横穿通道。

shots.scene: 大功率设备接在墙上专用插座
shots.prompt_en: A large drying oven plugged directly into its own dedicated wall socket. No people.
shots.narration: 大功率设备，用专用插座。

shots.section_title: 高压电源：先断电，不拆联锁
shots.scene: 小研关掉电泳仪电源，再取电极
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student switches off a gel electrophoresis power supply before touching the electrode leads.
shots.narration: 电泳仪等高压电源，先断电再操作。
overlay: 高压电源：先断电，不拆联锁

shots.section_title: 高压电源：先断电，不拆联锁
shots.scene: 拆掉安全联锁的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a safety interlock switch being bypassed with tape, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 安全联锁和防护罩，不能拆、不能短接。

shots.scene: 金属溶剂桶和接收容器用导线连到接地点
shots.prompt_en: A metal solvent drum and a receiving can connected by bonding wires to a ground point. No people.
shots.narration: 转移易燃溶剂，容器要接地。

shots.scene: 易燃品储存处旁的普通电器被打叉，防爆标志打勾
shots.prompt_en: An ordinary household fridge next to flammable bottles crossed out with a red X; an explosion-proof labeled cabinet with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 易燃场所，用符合要求的防爆电器。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现电压、电流、电阻、功率图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a battery, an arrow, a resistor and a bulb.
shots.narration: 懂电压电流，知道危险从哪来。

shots.scene: 电击、灼伤、火灾、静电四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a lightning shock, a burn mark, a flame and a static spark. No people.
shots.narration: 电击、灼伤、火灾、静电，都要防。

shots.scene: 完好电线、合格插线板、三孔插座打勾
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green checks: an intact cable, a proper power strip and a grounded three-hole socket. No people.
shots.narration: 线路完好，接地可靠，水电分开。

shots.scene: 欣欣在整洁的实验台旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside a tidy lab bench with neatly routed cables.
shots.narration: 安全用电，从懂电开始，下次见！
